qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Proprietary high-end defense electronics, radar systems, and tactical ground combat weapons (Carl-Gustaf, NLAW, AT4) with global NATO adoption. High barriers to entry and strong pricing power on proprietary munitions and Gripen life-cycle support.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (6=N, REJECT). Leading Nordic defense and tactical weapons champion, but multi-year FCF conversion structurally fails the 80% hurdle (~40-60%) due to heavy working capital absorption, milestone payment timing, and major capacity capex across Gripen and missile programs.
qualitative.evidence: Cumulative cash conversion targeted at only ~60% of EBIT by management. Historical FCF conversion to net income was ~68% in 2022, ~45% in 2023, and <30% in 2024. Long-cycle defense production (Gripen E, Kockums submarines, GlobalEye) absorbs significant working capital and capex.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
